description: This file implements Netlink socket communication for the WPEFramework, including serialization, deserialization, sending, and receiving Netlink messages, as well as maintaining message state and handling external dependencies.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Represents a Netlink message, providing serialization and deserialization of Netlink headers and payloads.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Derived class that manages sending and receiving Netlink messages over socket, maintaining message queues and state.

methods.name: uint16_t Serialize(uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t length) const
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream suitable for socket transmission.

methods.name: uint16_t Deserialize(const uint8_t stream[],const uint16_t streamLength)
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream to reconstruct Netlink message data.

methods.name: uint32_t Send(const Core::Netlink & outbound,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message, waits for acknowledgment if specified.

methods.name: uint32_t Exchange(const Core::Netlink & outbound,Core::Netlink & inbound,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response, facilitating request-response communication.

methods.name: uint16_t SendData(uint8_t * dataFrame,const uint16_t maxSendSize)
methods.description: Prepares data for transmission over the socket, selecting pending messages.

methods.name: uint16_t ReceiveData(uint8_t * dataFrame,const uint16_t receivedSize)
methods.description: Processes incoming data from the socket, matching responses to pending messages or deserializing new messages.

methods.name: void StateChange()
methods.description: Placeholder for signaling state transitions such as open or close.
